name: Workings: compare agent attempts
purpose: Help a learner inspect what changed when they repair an agent loop.

personas.name: A new agent builder
personas.context: Uses AI assistants and can read simple loops and objects; has not built an agent loop.
needs: Connect a code change to an observed result
Inspect earlier evidence without recreating a run
Attempt another task without a supplied repair
personas.source: Existing Workings brief and accepted product direction. Learning effort is unmeasured.

says: Hypothesis: what changed after my repair?
thinks: Hypothesis: I need to compare the two runs to explain the effect
does: The existing journey asks the learner to predict, edit, run, inspect, and repeat
feels: Hypothesis: remembering earlier trace details adds effort

journeys.trigger: A program fails to use a tool result or return an answer.

steps.action: Run and inspect the original loop
steps.pain: Several operations can explain a failed result
steps.need: Observed events from the actual program

steps.action: Change a block and make a prediction
steps.pain: The previous trace disappears in the current player
steps.need: Retain earlier evidence without treating it as current

steps.action: Run again and explain the observed difference
steps.pain: A successful result alone does not explain the cause
steps.need: Correct before-and-after evidence for the same case

steps.action: Try a fresh problem without a supplied repair
steps.pain: Following feedback may not produce independent understanding

outcomes.description: The learner can identify the change, cite before-and-after events, and explain the effect. Automated checks measure only whether the needed evidence is available.

dimensions.intent: Make observed evidence available during the repair
dimensions.tradeoff: Retain a complete same-case attempt before general history
dimensions.boundary: Only actual completed runs can supply comparison evidence
dimensions.review: Compare the displayed earlier program and events with the original run

dimensions.intent: Reduce the effort of finding a meaningful difference
dimensions.tradeoff: Compare self-directed inspection with an explicit difference summary
dimensions.boundary: Preserve prediction, learner control, and access to full evidence
dimensions.review: Observe explanation quality, effort, wrong turns, and hints

dimensions.intent: Fit comparison into the existing cabinet and lesson
dimensions.tradeoff: Use space for the current decision and disclose longer traces
dimensions.boundary: Keep both themes, narrow layouts, and keyboard access
dimensions.review: Operate the whole lesson in its intended medium

dimensions.tradeoff: Keep one earlier completed attempt per case
dimensions.boundary: No remote model calls or extra simulation runs for the comparison
dimensions.review: Check the actual browser journey and bundle size

dimensions.intent: Separate recorded comparisons from lesson grading
dimensions.tradeoff: Reuse the existing typed run records
dimensions.boundary: Do not change the engine or accepted lesson content
dimensions.review: Test same-case identity, snapshots, and invalidation

dimensions.intent: Compare distinct ways of inspecting a repair
dimensions.tradeoff: Retained history and guided differences serve the same task
dimensions.boundary: Novel presentation cannot replace correct evidence
dimensions.review: Compare against current Workings and each alternative

dimensions.intent: Reduce learner effort without adding provider cost
dimensions.tradeoff: Retain local evidence before adding services
dimensions.boundary: Unknown authoring or learning costs remain unknown
dimensions.review: Record evaluation time separately from human and authoring effort

dimensions.intent: Make the actual trial usable from the shared project folder
dimensions.boundary: Do not assume the host can reach container loopback
dimensions.review: Operate the same compiled app from a local file

craft.intent: Connect a learner edit with the evidence needed to understand it.
craft.audience_effect: The learner can inspect both attempts without losing their place.
craft.distinctive_character: Use actual program and event differences inside the existing cabinet.
anti_goals: Unrun answers or suggested repairs in the independent challenge
Test scores presented as learning gains
review_prompts: Is the evidence correct and reachable?
Does the comparison help explain a change without giving an unearned answer?
Does the whole lesson remain coherent?
